title: The chicken was hiding
lines: Under the carrots: 194 g of grilled chicken.
The AI saw only 35 g, and said so: confidence 0.3.

title: Right food, wrong table row
lines: Chia pudding was matched to dry chia seeds (486 kcal per 100 g).
That one row added 389 kcal. The plate held 11 g of chia.

title: Small miss, big calories
lines: The AI saw 60 g. A 20 g miss cost 115 kcal.

title: When the answer key is wrong
lines: The label lists quinoa and rice, no chicken.
The photo shows what looks like roast chicken; the AI added 335 kcal for it.
note: Our reading of the photo; a likely label error, not confirmed with the dataset authors.
